subject: massive differences between Mac OS and Centos

messages.author: c454b293eaa50635
messages.subject: massive differences between Mac OS and Centos
parts:
Hello,

I am running a negative binomial hierarchical model in a Mac. The results are really sensible. However, when a colleague runs the same model on the same dataset she gets very different results. We're talking about 6 orders of magnitude different. I am using INLA v19 whilst she's using v18. I want to believe that is not the cause of the issue but, could this be it?

Best wishes,
Felipe

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] massive differences between Mac OS and Centos
parts:
at some point there was a change in the default prior for the
overdispersion. can you can to fix the overdispersion for the
neg.binomial, and retry?
